messages:
Olivia: Quick async standup for the bench launch day
Maya: Did: finalized copy for carousel and landing hero. Blocker: waiting on high-res hero from design (cc @Design-bot). Today: prep email variants and social copy.
Sam: Will capture screenshots now and push to the shared drive. ETA 10m. Also can run the deploy if timing looks good.
Julian: Did: updated attribution tags and heatmap snippet. Blocker: none. Today: add UTMs for paid promos.
Olivia: Proposed publish time 10:30 PT to align with promo window. Thoughts?
Thomas: I have a 11-2 PT on-call block; can still supervise a 10:30 publish. If we move later Ill be limited.
Nora: Legal check: please avoid absolute comparative claims. Suggested phrasing: "outperforms in X configurations" instead of "beats". Can sign off in 20m.
Maya: Got it. I'll switch copy to Nora's phrasing and keep the A/B tweet variants.
Sam: Screenshots uploaded: https://drive.google.com/s/def456 (includes mobile + desktop).
Design-bot: hero_v2_final.png uploaded to /marketing/assets/bench/hero_v2_final.png (optimized).
Olivia: Nice. If Nora clears, we'll merge PR at 10:20 PT, deploy at 10:28 PT, publish 10:30 PT, email at 10:45 PT. @sam can you run the deploy steps at 10:28 so @Thomas can do post-publish checks?
Sam: Yep. Plan:
```
# deploy steps
1) merge PR to main
2) ./scripts/publish --page bench-launch
3) ./tools/cdn --invalidate /marketing/bench/*
4) post deploy: run smoke-check script ./scripts/smoke_check_marketing
```
Maya: I'll queue the two tweet variants and schedule email for 10:45 PT. Also marking the Trello card "ready".
Julian: I'll watch GA and Amplitude, will post initial traffic numbers at 10:55 PT.
Olivia: Blockers summary: legal phrasing (Nora) & final hero asset. If Nora approves, proceed to merge at 10:20.
Nora: Approved with softened language. No blockers from legal. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll ping here at 10:18 with merge readiness. Will post a short note in #eng-releases after deploy.
Olivia: Great work team 680. Any last-minute flags, drop them here and we'll handle.
